description: Synthetic M8.3 session interval fixtures. Not game data. expect: built (batch builds; the Rust tests assert the fixture-specific outcome) or error (build fails with error_code). A 'generate' member (oversized-input.json) is expanded by the test into that many events.

fixtures.note: Every event appears twice and in reverse order; the summary equals the single listing and merging it again is Unchanged
UTC goes backward and disagrees with the monotonic delta; durations stay monotonic and UTC is flagged uncertain
Two different events share one session and sequence
Logout, a later event with the same session ID, and a second session a day later; offline time is never counted
1025 events in one session exceed the 1024 bound
Monotonic reset inside a session ID, a recorder restart event and a second session ID
Spans over max_observed_span_ms are unclassified; estimated activity; paused recording is a gap
